components.name: Delta-matroid decision infrastructure
components.summary: Oracle-driven delta-matroid algorithms, matching and matrix backends, declarative workflow execution, adaptive portfolio scheduling, shared run context, and SQLite checkpoint/recovery for retry-safe workflows and portfolio turns.
known_limitations: Cancellation and deadlines are cooperative and cannot forcibly interrupt a blocked capability.
Serialized byte limits do not enforce CPU or memory quotas.
SQLite checkpoints recover declarative workflows only for retry-safe capabilities; they are not an external transaction log or exactly-once side-effect protocol.
Workflow approval flags are not authenticated identity or a full authorization service.
StrongPath must retain the verified-lift condition; parity correction alone is not a universally valid lift.
Exact matching optimum verification uses bounded exhaustive subset enumeration and is intended for small instances.
No production deployment, security audit, or SLO is claimed.
Portfolio recovery is available only when every registered strategy explicitly declares retry_safe=true; the declaration is trusted, not proven.
Portfolio recovery can replay the last turn from the previous pre-turn checkpoint and does not guarantee exactly-once side effects.

validation.scope: GitHub Actions run 40150460695 at commit fee5daf1a332a04b206668ee5d0bbaad2a715ede: 74 decision-module tests and 6 repository tests; registry/link checks, package install, compileall, CLI smoke tests, and wheel build passed.
validation.note: This validates the v0.8.0 portfolio checkpoint/resume implementation at the referenced commit. Hard isolation, authenticated authorization, authoritative state compare-and-swap, and production operations remain incomplete.
